blurb: Guests fish in Charleston waters targeting species like redfish, speckled trout, flounder, black drum, sheepshead, Spanish mackerel, cobia, mahi-mahi, tuna, wahoo, and billfish. Trips range from calm inshore creeks to offshore waters 30+ miles out. The company provides rods, reels, bait, tackle, and fishing licenses for passengers.
